status_policy: REVIEWED means the reusable substantive Phase 2D method passed independent QA; standards-evidence status is tracked separately in topic-local standards-claims.json and REVIEWED does not imply SOURCE_VERIFIED or APPROVED. PARTIAL is retained for substantive framework, canonicalization, jurisdiction, decision-logic, workpaper/control/data or scenario gaps. Unavailable authoritative text alone is not a substantive PARTIAL blocker when the proposition is explicitly ringfenced for audit.
